title: Data on Infant Care and Childcare Places, and Ratio of Available Places and Resident Children per Planning Area
what_it_is: Data on Infant Care and Childcare Places, and Ratio of Available Places and Resident Children per Planning Area

sections.label: Infant care and childcare places
sections.summary: As at end-2024, around 16,000 infant care places and 200,000 childcare places existed, with median utilisation rates of 69% and 74%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As at end-2024, there were around 16,000 infant care places, out of which around 70% were taken up.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As at end-2024, there were around 200,000 childcare places, out of which around 77% were taken up.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: When it comes to utilisation rates, they vary across Planning Areas and the median utilisation rates for infant care and childcare are 69% and 74% respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Utilisation rates for all Planning Areas are below 90%, for both infant care and childcare.

sections.label: Sengkang utilisation rates and planning
sections.summary: Sengkang's infant care and childcare utilisation rates are 74% and 83%, higher than national rates, so ECDA and HDB hold early discussions on new estates.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For Sengkang, specifically, infant care and childcare utilisation rates are at 74% and 83% respectively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This is higher than the national level infant care and childcare utilisation rates of around 70% and 77% respectively, which I had mentioned in my main reply.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Therefore, it is important, when it comes to building the infant care and childcare centres, that there are early discussions between the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) and the Housing and Development Board (HDB) to understand where are the new estates that are coming up.

sections.label: Tender process for centre operators
sections.summary: A tender process for operators takes place in advance so centre renovations are in tandem with residents' renovations and centres can be used.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There will be a tender process for operators to come in to operate these centres.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: That also takes place in advance so that by the time residents move in to these new estates and they have started renovating, this would be in tandem with when the renovations for these infant care and childcare centres take place, so that when the residents come in and they have young children, that these infant care and childcare centres can be used.
